roles.title: Help Desk Technician
roles.description: First point of contact for troubleshooting hardware, software, and connectivity issues for end users, often by phone, chat, or ticketing system.

roles.title: Technical Support Specialist
roles.description: Provides advanced remote and in-person support for hardware, software, and network issues, escalating complex problems as needed.

roles.title: Desktop Support Analyst
roles.description: Maintains and repairs desktop computers, peripherals, and mobile devices for an organization's workforce.

roles.title: Field Service Technician
roles.description: Travels to client or company sites to install, maintain, and repair technology equipment and infrastructure.

roles.title: Network Administrator
roles.description: Manages day-to-day operations of an organization's local and wide area networks, including switches, routers, and firewalls.

roles.title: Network Engineer
roles.description: Designs, implements, and optimizes network infrastructure to support performance, scalability, and reliability requirements.

roles.title: Systems Administrator
roles.description: Configures, maintains, and monitors servers and IT systems to ensure uptime, performance, and security across the organization.

roles.title: Wireless Network Engineer
roles.description: Designs and maintains enterprise wireless networks, ensuring coverage, capacity, and security across facilities.

roles.title: Network Support Specialist
roles.description: Provides tier 2 support for network connectivity issues, VPNs, and infrastructure hardware.

roles.title: Cybersecurity Analyst
roles.description: Monitors networks and systems for security incidents, analyzes threats, and implements defenses to protect organizational data.

roles.title: SOC Analyst
roles.description: Works within a Security Operations Center to triage alerts, investigate anomalies, and escalate confirmed incidents.

roles.title: Penetration Tester
roles.description: Simulates cyberattacks against systems, networks, and applications to identify exploitable vulnerabilities before attackers do.

roles.title: Security Engineer
roles.description: Designs and builds secure systems and infrastructure, implementing controls that reduce organizational risk.

roles.title: Incident Responder
roles.description: Leads the investigation and containment of active security breaches, coordinating remediation and post-incident review.

roles.title: Vulnerability Analyst
roles.description: Identifies, prioritizes, and tracks remediation of security vulnerabilities across an organization's technology stack.

roles.title: Information Security Analyst
roles.description: Develops and enforces security policies, conducts risk assessments, and ensures regulatory compliance.

roles.title: Cloud Security Specialist
roles.description: Secures cloud environments and workloads, implementing controls across identity, network, and data protection layers.

roles.title: Cloud Administrator
roles.description: Manages day-to-day operations of cloud infrastructure, including provisioning, monitoring, and cost optimization.

roles.title: Cloud Engineer
roles.description: Builds and maintains scalable cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines using infrastructure-as-code practices.

roles.title: Cloud Architect
roles.description: Designs enterprise cloud strategies and architectures, balancing scalability, security, and cost across cloud platforms.

roles.title: Site Reliability Engineer
roles.description: Ensures the reliability, scalability, and performance of production systems through automation and observability.

roles.title: DevOps Engineer
roles.description: Bridges development and operations teams, automating build, test, and deployment pipelines for faster, reliable releases.

roles.title: Data Analyst
roles.description: Collects, cleans, and analyzes data to uncover trends and support business decision-making through reports and dashboards.

roles.title: Data Scientist
roles.description: Builds statistical models and machine learning solutions to extract insights and predictions from complex datasets.

roles.title: Business Intelligence Analyst
roles.description: Transforms raw data into actionable business insights using dashboards, KPIs, and reporting frameworks.

roles.title: Database Administrator
roles.description: Manages database performance, security, backups, and availability for mission-critical applications.

roles.title: AI/Machine Learning Engineer
roles.description: Designs, trains, and deploys machine learning models into production systems and applications.

roles.title: Software Developer
roles.description: Designs, builds, and tests applications and software systems to meet user and business requirements.

roles.title: QA/Test Engineer
roles.description: Develops and executes test plans to identify defects and ensure software quality before release.

roles.title: Web Developer
roles.description: Builds and maintains websites and web applications, focusing on front-end, back-end, or full-stack development.

roles.title: IT Project Manager
roles.description: Plans, executes, and closes technology projects, managing scope, budget, timelines, and stakeholder communication.

roles.title: Scrum Master
roles.description: Facilitates agile development teams, removing blockers and ensuring adherence to Scrum practices and sprint goals.

roles.title: Business Analyst
roles.description: Gathers and analyzes business requirements, bridging the gap between stakeholders and technical teams.

roles.title: IT Coordinator
roles.description: Supports IT project teams with scheduling, documentation, procurement tracking, and administrative coordination.
